Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
retrieve_data;
check_package_failure;
declare
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button Number;
 CNT NUMBER:=0; 
begin 
 if :ctrl_block.chapter_id is null
 then
 clear_form(no_validate);
 pause;
 message('Please Enter a Chapter ID'); 
 return;
 end if;
 
 select chapter_name into :ctrl_block.chapter_name from chapters
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_block.chapter_id; 
 select COUNT(*) into CNT from chapters
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_block.chapter_id AND sysdate between chapters.eff_date and nvl(chapters.term_date,sysdate+365); 
 IF CNT=0 THEN
 clear_form(no_validate);
 show_error('11511');
 return;
 ELSE
 
 go_item('PB_RETRIEVE');
 END IF; 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 al_id := Find_Alert('new_chapter_id_alert');
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id );
 set_alert_property(al_id, title, 'New Id?');
 set_alert_property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Do you really want to create new Chapter Id?');
 set_alert_button_property(al_id, alert_button1, label, 'Yes');
 set_alert_button_property(al_id, alert_button2, label, 'No');

 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 go_block('chapters');
 end if;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.CHAPTER_ID' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.chapter_id',action);
 end if;
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_chapter_id',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_chapter_id',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;
